title: NFLPA "strongly opposes" proposed changes to California workers' compensation laws

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFLPA "strongly opposes" proposed changes to California workers' compensation laws
sources.description: Although most of an NFL player's rights and responsibilities are governed by the Collective Bargaining Agreement between the NFL Players Association and the NFL, the geographic location of a player's employment has a potentially significant impact on their overall work experience.
